Barn 1.3.0 adds Linux guest clock synchronization, short image selectors,
and a fix for macOS network setup. It embeds Linux image catalog `2026112101`
and selects macOS 27.2.1 (`26B131`) for a new Mac base.

## Upgrade from 1.2.0

If your inventory uses `vm_image: rocky` or `vm_image: ubuntu`, those names
now select Rocky Linux 10 and Ubuntu 26.04. Set them to `el9` or `u24` to
keep the 1.2.0 targets. An omitted image still selects Ubuntu 24.04 on the
host's native architecture. Run `barn plan` to review any change to an
existing deployment. Replacing a guest's image requires `barn recreate`.

On macOS, `barn setup` accepts an active sharing service with both custom
subnet keys absent from its vmnet preferences. If macOS restricts access to
the preferences, run `sudo -v` in the same terminal and retry. Barn still
checks the actual host interfaces, routes, and selected node addresses.

## Linux clocks and images

Use `barn time status` to measure a running guest against the host and
`barn time sync` to correct it over management SSH. The guest can be offline
from the Internet. Startup checks correct offsets greater than two seconds
after the guest is ready. `--no-wait` skips the check. To check every minute,
run `barn time auto enable`. Use `barn time auto disable` to remove the job.

`e`, `u`, and `d` select Rocky Linux 10, Ubuntu 26.04, and Debian 13.
The `a` suffix selects arm64, while `x` and `i` select amd64. For example,
`barn image info el10a` and `barn plan -I d13x` select a distribution and
architecture together. An explicit architecture that conflicts with the
image suffix produces an error.

The signed catalog refreshes 12 artifacts across amd64 and arm64. It includes
Rocky Linux 9.9 and 10.3, new Debian 12 and 13 cloud builds, and new Ubuntu
22.04 and 26.04 cloud builds. Rocky 10.3 includes the kernel modules required
by Docker's default bridge networking and firewall. `el8` and `u22` are
deprecated. The catalog retains all previous exact versions. Barn 1.2.0 users
can also activate this catalog with `barn update`.

## macOS guests

On a Mac with no prepared base, `barn mac setup` and `barn mac up` select
Apple's macOS 27.2.1 restore image. On an existing installation, run
`barn mac image update` to select the new base for future VMs.
`barn mac image ls` shows which base each existing VM uses.

## Installation

Stop running macOS guests before upgrading `Barn.app`. For Homebrew, run
`brew update` followed by `brew upgrade pgsty/infra/barn`. To install the
versioned archive, run the following commands after the assets are published.

```bash
curl -fLO https://github.com/pgsty/barn/releases/download/v1.3.0/install.sh
BARN_VERSION=1.3.0 bash install.sh
barn version
```

See the [full changelog](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/blob/v1.3.0/CHANGELOG.md)
and [source changes since 1.2.0](https://github.com/pgsty/barn/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0).
